properties.displayName: AKS Linux node pools should set a default seccomp profile at the kubelet
properties.description: Audits every AKS cluster and flags it when a Linux node pool does not set kubeletConfig.seccompDefault to an approved value. seccompDefault=RuntimeDefault makes the container runtime apply a seccomp profile to every pod that does not declare its own securityContext.seccompProfile, closing the gap left by workload-level policy alone. Windows node pools do not support seccomp and are excluded. IMPORTANT: kubeletConfig.seccompDefault is a recent AKS API property. Confirm the policy alias exists in your tenant before assigning (see README section 'Verifying aliases'). If the alias is absent, rely on the workload-level built-in 975ce327-682c-4f2e-aa46-b9598289b86c instead.

metadata.description: Node pools whose kubeletConfig.seccompDefault is unset or not in this list are non-compliant.
Audit flags non-compliant clusters. Deny blocks cluster or node pool writes that would leave seccompDefault unset. Start on Audit.
